name: Stella by Starlight
text: [overview] A serious mixed line up the Wheeler Peak headwall above the cirque: snow and ice to a ramp, wet rock beside a water gully, aid through dripping overhangs, then a long icy ramp trending left to exit just below the summit.
[detailed_rack] Bring snow and ice anchors, plus stoppers, hexes and thin pitons for rock.

name: Terminal Cancer
text: [overview] A famed ski descent skied throughout winter, since snow is often good and avalanche conditions stable, the road is usually close, and the line is strikingly beautiful.
[what_to_bring] crampons and ice axe — optional, for the sometimes icy upper section
